title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Rides the AI Threat Wave, But Can It Lead the Pack?
excerpt: AI is now greatly advancing both sides of the cybersecurity war, with data increasingly favoring attackers. This isn’t an isolated data point, as Check Point...
content_html:
Sheryar Siddiq

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 4:10 AM EDT 4 min read

AI is now greatly advancing both sides of the cybersecurity war, with data increasingly favoring attackers. This isn't an isolated data point, as Check Point's 2026 Cyber Security Report, its 14th annual study, found that organizations fell victim to an average of 1,968 cyberattacks per week back in 2025, a 70% increase from 2023, as attackers increasingly make use of automation and AI to move more quickly and operate across a number of attack surfaces at the same time. Meanwhile, Mandiant's M-Trends 2026 report further highlights the timeframe problem: 28.3% of revealed vulnerabilities are now exploited in less than 24 hours, with time-to-exploit effectively negative when assaults arrive before patches.

Accelerated Metrics

That narrow window between vulnerability discovery and attack is exactly the dynamic that is altering business security budgets, and Wall Street sees CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) as one of the companies best positioned to gain from it. In fiscal Q1 2027, the company's revenue reached $1.39 billion, up 26% year-over-year, while ending ARR was a record $5.51 billion, up 24%, with net new ARR of $256 million increasing 32% year-over-year, indicating an acceleration rather than a slowing in the pace of new business. Profitability scaled alongside the expansion, with non-GAAP net income growing to $283 million from $184.7 million the year before.

Valuation Realities

Although CrowdStrike's underlying trajectory remains robust, its valuation multiple is the key source of concern for institutional investors. Shares are currently trading at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 119.92x, which is a significant premium above prominent cybersecurity rivals such as Palo Alto Networks (84.74x), SentinelOne (39x), and Zscaler (32.72x). At almost 120x forward earnings, the current stock price requires sustained mid-to-high 20% annual revenue growth and continued margin improvement over several years to justify trading levels in hindsight.

Against this backdrop, Stifel's July 17 price target increase to $230 from $220, following investor meetings with CrowdStrike's CFO on AI tailwinds, fiscal 2027 confidence, and Falcon Flex traction, reads as sell-side confirmation of a growth story already supported by the company's own numbers, rather than primary evidence for it.

The firm also cited a growing sales pipeline supporting confidence in CrowdStrike's net-new annual recurring revenue guidance increase issued last quarter, as well as management's stated willingness to increase the size and pace of acquisitions, which would be funded with a combination of stock and debt.

content_html_zh:
谢里亚尔·西迪克

2026 年 7 月 29 日星期三，美国东部时间凌晨 4:10 阅读 4 分钟

人工智能现在正在极大地推进网络安全战争的双方，数据越来越有利于攻击者。 这不是一个孤立的数据点，Check Point 的第 14 次年度研究《2026 年网络安全报告》发现，2025 年，组织平均每周遭受 1,968 起网络攻击，比 2023 年增加了 70%，因为攻击者越来越多地利用自动化和人工智能来更快地行动并同时跨多个攻击面进行操作。 与此同时，Mandiant 的 M-Trends 2026 报告进一步强调了时间范围问题：28.3% 的已发现漏洞现在在不到 24 小时内被利用，当攻击在补丁之前到达时，利用时间实际上为负值。

加速指标

漏洞发现和攻击之间的狭窄窗口正是改变企业安全预算的动力，华尔街将 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）视为最有可能从中获利的公司之一。 2027财年第一季度，该公司收入达到13.9亿美元，同比增长26%，期末ARR达到创纪录的55.1亿美元，增长24%，净新增ARR为2.56亿美元，同比增长32%，这表明新业务的步伐是加速而不是放缓。 盈利能力随着扩张而扩大，非 GAAP 净利润从上一年的 1.847 亿美元增至 2.83 亿美元。

估值现实

尽管 CrowdStrike 的基本轨迹仍然强劲，但其估值倍数是机构投资者关注的主要来源。 目前，该股的预期市盈率为 119.92 倍，远高于 Palo Alto Networks (84.74 倍)、SentinelOne (39 倍) 和 Zscaler (32.72 倍) 等著名网络安全竞争对手。 以近 120 倍的预期市盈率计算，目前的股价需要持续中高 20% 的年收入增长以及未来几年持续的利润率改善，才能证明事后交易水平的合理性。

在此背景下，在与 CrowdStrike 首席财务官就 AI 顺风、2027 财年信心和 Falcon Flex 牵引力举行投资者会议后，Stifel 7 月 17 日的目标价从 220 美元上调至 230 美元，这被视为卖方对公司自身数据已经支持的增长故事的确认，而不是主要证据。

该公司还指出，不断增长的销售渠道支撑了人们对 CrowdStrike 上季度发布的年度经常性净收入指引增长的信心，以及管理层表示愿意增加收购规模和步伐的意愿，收购将通过股票和债务相结合的方式提供资金。
